sara_ml: quick flag: miraql-v1 q3a canary shows translation quality drop vs fp16 on zh->en and ar->en. BLEU 27.8 -> 24.3 on our val slice; chrF and embed-sim also down.

james_rte: rough buckets?

sara_ml: numeric+bracket CJK and RTL bracket cases. Short sentences with ZWJ/ZWSP and alnum runs are worst. Example (zh)->en: SRC: 会議 A-2 -> FP16 outputs "A-2" but q3a often "A - 2" splitting the token. Token diff shows q3a emits separate ["A","-","2"].

maria_i18n: that smells like detok/joining, not tokenizer. ZWJ loss can split graphemes and flip bidi bracket orientation.

kevin_infra: can pause canary if needed. deploy-bot: use `/canary pause miraql-v1-q3a`.

sara_ml: quick test: forcing legacy detok in q3a recovers A-2 in 17/20 samples and moves BLEU back ~0.8 on that slice.

james_rte: plan: pause rollout, deploy detok fallback canary, run mixed-precision final-layer ablation overnight if needed, add i18n regression slice to onboarding CI.

maria_i18n: I'll seed a 2k i18n testset (ZWJ, fullwidth digits, RTL brackets).

sara_ml: I'll open PR for detok fallback + unit tests.

kevin_infra: pausing canary now. deploy-bot: Canary paused, traffic back to fp16 baseline.

sara_ml: filing incident and linking thread. Thanks all.
